_doc: 30-pair calibration set for ANTSE-295: difflib→cosine migration. Each pair has a draft and actual response. Run tests/test_feedback_scorer.py::TestCalibrationSet to compute both scores.

pairs.label: identical
pairs.draft: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again.
pairs.actual: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again.

pairs.label: near_identical_punctuation
pairs.draft: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again.
pairs.actual: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again!

pairs.label: minor_rewording
pairs.draft: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again.
pairs.actual: I've unlocked your account. Go ahead and try logging in now.

pairs.label: same_meaning_different_words
pairs.draft: Please reset your password using the self-service portal at https://password.example.com.
pairs.actual: You can change your password yourself by visiting the password reset page at https://password.example.com.

pairs.label: added_context
pairs.draft: The VPN issue has been resolved. Please reconnect.
pairs.actual: The VPN issue has been resolved on our end — it was a certificate expiry. Please reconnect and let us know if it works.

pairs.label: trimmed_response
pairs.draft: Hi there! I've checked your request and the software has been installed on your machine. You should see it in your Start menu. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Best regards, IT Support.
pairs.actual: The software has been installed. Check your Start menu.

pairs.label: completely_different_topic
pairs.draft: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again.
pairs.actual: The printer on the 3rd floor has been restocked with paper.

pairs.label: opposite_meaning
pairs.draft: Your request has been approved and the changes are live.
pairs.actual: Unfortunately, your request has been denied due to policy restrictions.

pairs.label: admin_steps_similar
pairs.draft: Navigate to Admin Console > Users > Find the user > Click Reset Password > Confirm.
pairs.actual: Go to the Admin Console, search for the user under Users, and hit Reset Password.

pairs.label: admin_steps_different_procedure
pairs.draft: Navigate to Admin Console > Users > Find the user > Click Reset Password > Confirm.
pairs.actual: Run the PowerShell command: Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity username -Reset

pairs.label: needs_info_to_resolution
pairs.draft: Could you provide your employee ID and the specific application you're trying to access?
pairs.actual: I've granted you access to the Salesforce application. You should be able to log in now.

pairs.label: formal_to_casual
pairs.draft: We have processed your request for additional storage. Your quota has been increased to 50GB.
pairs.actual: Done! Bumped your storage to 50GB.

pairs.label: casual_to_formal
pairs.draft: Done! Your access is sorted.
pairs.actual: Dear User, your access request has been processed and the permissions have been applied to your account.

pairs.label: self_service_link_same
pairs.draft: You can resolve this yourself by following the guide at https://docs.example.com/vpn-setup.
pairs.actual: Please follow the VPN setup guide here: https://docs.example.com/vpn-setup

pairs.label: self_service_different_link
pairs.draft: You can resolve this yourself by following the guide at https://docs.example.com/vpn-setup.
pairs.actual: Try the instructions at https://docs.example.com/network-troubleshooting instead.

pairs.label: multilingual_equivalent
pairs.draft: Your ticket has been resolved. Please confirm if the issue persists.
pairs.actual: The ticket is resolved. Let us know if you still have problems.

pairs.label: empty_actual
pairs.draft: Your account has been unlocked. Please try logging in again.

pairs.label: boilerplate_greeting_added
pairs.draft: The software license has been assigned to your account.
pairs.actual: Hi John, thanks for reaching out! The software license has been assigned to your account. Let me know if you need anything else. Best, Sarah

pairs.label: heavily_rewritten_same_resolution
pairs.draft: I've added you to the security group for the shared drive. You should now be able to access the files in the Marketing folder.
pairs.actual: Access granted. The Marketing shared drive should now appear when you open File Explorer. If it doesn't show up within 15 minutes, try logging out and back in.

pairs.label: escalation_instead_of_resolution
pairs.draft: The issue has been resolved by restarting the service.
pairs.actual: I'm escalating this to the infrastructure team as the root cause requires server-side changes.

pairs.label: same_action_more_detail
pairs.draft: Password has been reset. New temporary password sent to your email.
pairs.actual: I've reset your password. A temporary password has been sent to your registered email address (j***@company.com). Please change it within 24 hours through the portal.

pairs.label: typo_correction_only
pairs.draft: Your acces has been grated to the Salesforce aplication.
pairs.actual: Your access has been granted to the Salesforce application.

pairs.label: completely_unrelated
pairs.draft: The quarterly budget review has been scheduled for next Monday.
pairs.actual: Please install the latest Chrome update to fix the rendering issue.

pairs.label: acknowledgment_only
pairs.draft: I've investigated the issue and found that your email forwarding rule was misconfigured. I've corrected it to forward to your personal email as requested.
pairs.actual: Thanks, noted.

pairs.label: same_template_different_values
pairs.draft: User john.doe has been added to the group DL-Marketing with role Member.
pairs.actual: User jane.smith has been added to the group DL-Engineering with role Admin.

pairs.label: question_answer_mismatch
pairs.draft: What version of Windows are you running?
pairs.actual: I've updated your Windows to the latest version.

pairs.label: partial_overlap
pairs.draft: I've completed the following: 1) Reset your password 2) Unlocked your account 3) Added you to the VPN group.
pairs.actual: Password has been reset and account unlocked. For VPN access, you'll need to submit a separate request.

pairs.label: same_resolution_different_format
pairs.draft:
Steps taken:
- Disabled old MFA device
- Enrolled new phone as MFA device
- Verified login works

You're all set.
pairs.actual: I've swapped your MFA device from the old phone to your new one. Tested and login is working fine now.

pairs.label: negation_flip
pairs.draft: This change does not require manager approval.
pairs.actual: This change requires manager approval before we can proceed.

pairs.label: short_vs_detailed
pairs.draft: Done.
pairs.actual: I've completed the configuration changes to your email account including setting up the auto-reply, updating your signature, and configuring the forwarding rules to your team distribution list.
